Plot original and landmark-registered functional trajectories side by side

etr_plot_registration.Rd

Does not apply new registration or recompute warps. Every line is plotted on the source grid in observed curve order with matched original/registered panels. Frozen Python 1.2 source's (fig,axes) runtime return and pixel-perfect Matplotlib rendering are deliberately not claimed by native R.

Usage

etr_plot_registration(
    result, dimension = NULL, max_curves = 20L,
    strict_source_record = FALSE, ...)

Arguments

result

Real native landmark-registration result retaining original and registered trajectories on their original common time grid, dimension names and curve identifiers.

dimension

Exact named native functional dimension. If NULL, select the first source channel.

max_curves

Positive integer maximum number of first-seen curves displayed in each panel.

strict_source_record

Return a native R scientific artist record preserving Python's two source panels, per-curve data, alpha 0.25, axis titles, figure size intent and curve ordering. No real Python Figure or Axes objects are produced.

...

Native base graphics plot options.

Value

Default invisible original and registered per-curve data frames and metadata. Strict mode returns a native R two-panel source scientific artist record.
